### Tempogram Analysis

Row {data-height=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Energy Novelty Function

```{r}
"features/erik-l-2.json" |>
  compmus_energy_novelty() |> 
  ggplot(aes(t, novelty)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Energy Novelty",
       title = "Energy Novelty for Für Elise (Human Performance)",
       subtitle = "Peaks correspond to sudden changes in energy")
```

Row {data-height=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Regular Tempogram (Human Performance)

```{r}
# Regular tempogram for Für Elise
"features/erik-l-2.json" |>
  compmus_tempogram(window_size = 8, hop_size = 1, cyclic = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = bpm, fill = power)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Tempo (BPM)",
       title = "Tempogram for Für Elise (Human Performance)",
       subtitle = "Window size: 8 seconds") +
  theme_classic()
```

### Cyclic Tempogram (Human Performance)

```{r}
# Cyclic tempogram for Für Elise
"features/erik-l-2.json" |>
  compmus_tempogram(window_size = 8, hop_size = 1, cyclic = TRUE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = bpm, fill = power)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Tempo (BPM)",
       title = "Cyclic Tempogram for Für Elise (Human Performance)",
       subtitle = "Window size: 8 seconds, Cyclic representation") +
  theme_classic()
```
